viewing_check: Estimate $30-50, current bid $15. At viewing ignore the books and go straight to the deeds: count them, read dates (anything pre-1850 or a Crown grant is the prize), parties, and property location (Launceston town lots are best), check whether any are on vellum/parchment with seals. Read the title page of the large 'PHOTOPRINTS FAR...' hardback and the two unreadable green spines. Check the Bethell imprint (Cox Kay 1957 cloth = first; anything else = reprint). Only worth bidding beyond ~A$60-80 hammer if the deeds are early or numerous. Also pull out the dark cloth hardback lying flat at the bottom of the box (spine not visible in any photo) and check its title page and date.
